packageRules.description: Auto-merge dev tooling (linters, formatters, type checkers, test libs) on minor/patch — these break loudly in CI, not silently in prod.
Auto-merge backend dev-group tools (ruff, ty, pytest, import-linter, etc.) on minor/patch.
Auto-merge GitHub Actions on minor/patch; majors still get a manual review PR.
Auto-merge pre-commit hook bumps on minor/patch.

Constraint 15 (AGENTS.md): keep every uv pin identical. Group the PyPI pin (setup.sh, pyproject [tool.uv], CI), the Docker builder image, and the mise toolchain pin into one PR so they always bump together.
Constraint 15: keep every Postgres image pin identical (docker-compose + the two Python literals) — a mismatched image risks false migration diffs. One grouped PR.
Group Node runtime pins (mise, frontend Dockerfile, setup-node) so the runtime version bumps in a single reviewable PR.
Group pnpm pins (mise, package.json packageManager, pnpm/action-setup) — these are currently drifted (11.15.0 vs CI 11.11.0) and must move together.
Major runtime/image and framework bumps are review-only: no automerge, explicit label so they surface on the dashboard.

customManagers.description: Constraint 15: Postgres image tag hard-coded as a Python string literal in the migration generator and the integration-test fixture (not visible to the docker-compose manager).
Constraint 15: uv version pinned as a PyPI package in the cloud setup script and in pyproject [tool.uv] required-version.
Constraint 15: uv version passed to astral-sh/setup-uv in CI (a workflow input the github-actions manager does not touch).
